To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the QoE can be efficiently modeled and synthesized by using the ANN method in the real environment, with the QoS measurement, to evaluate and improve various types of multimedia service on the cellular networks based on user centric QoE metric.

the QoE score of the multimedia services can be estimated by using the QoS parameters with the help of the ANN method and the QoE can be synthesized by using the QoE estimation results, for improving the performance and the QoI of the network.

the proposed QoE modelling method, based on ANN, can be effectively used to estimate and synthesize the OS score, based on the collected datasets, for each of multimedia service, in order to improve the quality of cellular networks.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new approach for improving the performance and the user satisfaction in the cellular networks, based on the proposed QoE model, which has been created by using the ANN method.
the QoE evaluation and improvement of multimedia services on cellular networks.
the improvement of the QoE of the users in the cellular network, by using the QoS parameters with the help of the ANN method.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the proposed QoE modelling method, based on QoS parameters, using ANN, is able to efficiently synthesize the QoS parameters in terms of QoE, which is a very important step towards the improvement of multimedia services on cellular networks.
, the QoE can be efficiently modeled and synthesized by using the ANN method, to evaluate the quality of the networks and to improve the performance in terms of user satisfaction.
the QoE based on the QoE score can be efficiently estimated and synthesized, by using the ANN method, to improve the performance of cellular networks, based on the user satisfaction.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the ANN method can be used as an efficient tool to estimate and synthesize the user satisfaction in terms of QoE, for improving the performance in the cellular network.

, the QoE can be efficiently estimated and synthesized by using the ANN method and it can be used as an effective tool for the MNO to improve the quality of network and to increase the user satisfaction, based on the business perspective.
the QoE metric can be used as a key factor in the evaluation and synthesis of QoE in order to improve the quality of cellular networks.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the QoE can be efficiently estimated and synthesized by using ANN method in order to evaluate and improve multimedia services on the networks.
the QoE score can be estimated by using the QoS parameters with the help of ANN and it is possible to improve the QoE by improving the QoS parameters of the networks.
the QoE metric can be effectively used for the improvement of the network quality and the user experience.
